subject.title: fix(matrix): deliver reasoning blocks as m.notice when /reasoning on [AI-assisted]

question: After this PR is rebased to use `reasoningPayloadsEnabled`, should maintainers require live Matrix/Element send-read proof before merge, or explicitly accept the in-memory Matrix adapter transcript as enough?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible and the fix direction is narrow, but the repository proof gate for external PRs asks for real behavior proof and the contributor states they lack Matrix homeserver credentials.

options.title: Require live Matrix proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Matrix/Element room transcript, logs, or recording showing `/reasoning on` emits an `m.notice` and `/reasoning off` suppresses reasoning before merge.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly waive the live proof requirement after the branch reuses the existing gate and the source-path tests remain focused.

recommendation.title: Require live Matrix proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Matrix/Element room transcript, logs, or recording showing `/reasoning on` emits an `m.notice` and `/reasoning off` suppresses reasoning before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the current shared reasoning payload gate that this PR must reuse, making them the best available owner for the proof/contract call.
